description: The pie chart titled “Distribution of Difficulty” depicts the proportion of dataset entries across difficulty levels, showing five slices in total. The slices are labeled with percentages and correspond to: Medium in pink at approximately 51.8%, Hard in blue at approximately 25.7%, Easy in light green at approximately 11.2%, Very hard in light orange at approximately 6.5%, and Very easy in light lavender/purple at approximately 4.7%. A legend labeled “Difficulty” appears in the upper-left and lists each category with associated counts (Medium 725,892; Hard 360,137; Easy 157,053; Very hard 91,576; Very easy 65,332). The percentage labels are displayed outside the pie near their respective slices, and no slices appear exploded or otherwise visually emphasized; the slices appear arranged roughly from largest to smallest.
